bluf: A Jordanian court sentenced three men to death over a church attack in Karak governorate that killed nine, according to BBC News World, Al Jazeera and France 24. BBC News World reported that Hamas and Israeli military officials confirmed the death of Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis in a strike on a Gaza camp.

changes.text: Updated since previous brief: Green earthquake (Magnitude 6.1M, Depth:535km) in Fiji 05/11/2026 17:21 UTC, Few people affected in 100km.

disasters.text: GDACS reported a magnitude 5.5 earthquake at a depth of 469.881 km in Fiji at 05:15:02 AM on 11/15/2026, potentially affecting few people within 100 km.

items.text: BBC News World reported that Hamas and IDF officials confirmed the death of Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis in a strike on a Gaza camp.

France 24 reported that Iran's military confirmed an attack on a US military base in Bahrain, while Bahrain's military said it intercepted several Iranian attacks; the report described this as Iran's second targeting of Bahrain in three days.
On Sunday, a Jordanian court sentenced three men to death over an attack on a church funeral in Karak governorate that killed nine.
Al Jazeera reported waves of drone attacks on power stations in Sudan, resulting in power outages.
BBC News World reported that US officials attributed US flight disruption to old equipment overloading, not a cyberattack.
